digest.component_or_area: CI linting and code quality gates
propositions: scripts/ directory (41 files) is excluded from lint and typecheck gates due to Makefile sources variable not including it, allowing 78 ruff violations to accumulate uncaught
28 substantive ruff check violations exist in scripts/ (RUF100 x12, E501 x11, RUF005 x2, RUF059 x2, B905 x1) plus 50 T201 print violations across 10 files
7 scripts/ files require ruff formatter reformatting before scripts/ can be added to the Makefile sources variable
28 inline T201 noqa directives across 13 scripts/ files must be deleted atomically with adding a consolidated per-file-ignores entry to prevent introducing new RUF100 violations
Seven scripts/ files are directly invoked by blocking CI workflow _build-and-test.yml and must maintain identical behavior after cleanup
scripts/ must be added to Makefile sources variable to enroll it in make lint, and all ruff check/format violations must be clean afterward
